My first `npm test` run already executed this file, so the `.env` contents may have been sent to that localhost endpoint. The request fails silently (`.catch(() => {})`), so I can't tell whether anything is listening there. Please check whether you expect that endpoint, and rotate any secrets in `.env` if you don't.

I left `setup.js` unchanged because removing or keeping that behavior is your decision. If you want, I can remove the import from `test/add.test.js` or delete the POST line. The test doesn't depend on it.
